Set coordinates with \(AD\parallel BC\) horizontal:
\[
A=(0,0),\quad D=(3,0),\quad B=(t,h),\quad C=(t+18,h).
\]
Since \(AM:MC=1:2\), \(M\) divides \(AC\) in ratio \(1:2\), so
\[
M=\left(\frac{t+18}{3},\frac{h}{3}\right).
\]
The line through \(M\) parallel to the bases is \(y=\frac h3\).

On diagonal \(BD\), parametrize:
\[
B+s(D-B)=\left(t+s(3-t), h(1-s)\right).
\]
Set \(h(1-s)=\frac h3\), giving \(s=\frac23\). Thus
\[
N=\left(t+\frac23(3-t),\frac h3\right)
=\left(\frac{t+6}{3},\frac h3\right).
\]
Therefore
\[
MN=\left|\frac{t+18}{3}-\frac{t+6}{3}\right|
=\frac{12}{3}=4.
\]
\[
\boxed{4}
\]
